=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:128-136 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack can emit V2 chains that exceed the extractor's accepted chunk cap.
  WHY: the writer computes total from encoded size but does not guard the write loop, while extraction rejects total > MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST and falls back to stale V1 state.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:143-144 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack can emit V2 chains that exceed the extractor's accepted chunk cap.
  WHY: the writer computes total from encoded size but does not guard against MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST, so oversized states become unreadable on the next poll.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:327-453 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: the test helper resolves duplicate V2 parts oldest-first instead of matching production's newest-first semantics.
  WHY: it walks comments forward and uses setdefault, while cmd_extract walks reversed(comments), so retried/reposted chunks are stitched differently in CI than in production.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4967-5055 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: the notification path can emit a FAILED release message when only workflow-log-analysis-test fails even though that job is non-gating.
  WHY: the notify logic still treats the job as a failure signal in the status output even though it is excluded from the gating check.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5077-5082 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: workflow-log-analysis-test is included in the FAILED-branch status line, so a non-gating log-analysis failure is still surfaced as a FAILED release message.
  WHY: the branch does not gate on LOG_ANALYSIS, but it still prints the job as part of the failure status; reviewers disagreed on impact, with moonshot calling it low priority and qwen rejecting it as non-gating.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-137 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_looks_like_re_escape_output` returns True for the empty string, which can let a blank regex survive validation.
  WHY: `re.escape("")` round-trips to `""`, so a corrupted or hand-edited state file could carry an empty pattern even though the normal capture path filters blanks.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:175-180 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: an empty mnc_regex is treated as a substring of every mc_regex and can be dropped from the overlap-pruning set.
  WHY: `'' in mc_regex` is always true, so a blank forbidden pattern is silently removed whenever any must_contain pattern exists.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
